environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed in an EKS pod. Vault transit backend uses an AWS CloudHSM-backed seal (PKCS#11 provider, Luna Network HSM 7 partition). The named key 'session-key' is type=hmac-sha256 with key material generated inside the HSM (non-exportable, CKA_EXTRACTABLE=false, CKA_SENSITIVE=true). The pod's Kubernetes ServiceAccount is bound to a Vault role via JWT auth that ONLY permits transit/verify/session-key - the sign capability is explicitly denied by a Sentinel policy (enforcement level: hard-mandatory) that checks request path and operation. Additionally, the Vault token issued to this workload has a response-wrapping TTL of 0 (no wrapping) and uses a Vault namespace 'prod/frontend' where the policy is scoped. The pod runs with a gVisor (runsc) runtime class that intercepts execve syscalls - the OCI runtime spec has a custom seccomp profile that returns EPERM for execve/execveat for any process not matching the main binary path (/app/service). Network policy (Cilium L7) restricts egress from the pod to only port 8200 on the Vault service IP and port 443 for telemetry.

config.network_policy: Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy: egress to vault.vault.svc:8200 and telemetry.monitoring.svc:443 only
